ideas.name: Microsoft Corporation
ideas.thesis: Appeared in all 6 overnight screens with unanimous high conviction. MSFT enters its July 29 AMC print at a multi-year low forward P/E of 20.6x — its cheapest multiple since 2023 — after a ~20% 52-week drawdown driven by AI capex fears. Consensus sits at $87.6B revenue / $4.24 EPS with an Azure CC growth bogey of 36% against company guidance of 39–40%, suggesting a beatable bar with meaningful upside if the AI capex ROI narrative turns. The Fed decision on the same day (July 29) creates a two-sided binary, making defined-risk bull call spreads strongly preferred over outright calls.
ideas.catalyst: Q4 FY2026 earnings report July 29 AMC, simultaneous with FOMC rate decision
ideas.edge: Forward P/E 20.6x (cheapest since 2023) vs. consensus analyst PT ~$590; Azure guided 39–40% CC growth vs. a ~36% bogey — positive surprise bar is achievable
ideas.bull_case: Azure beats the 36% bogey and approaches guided 39–40%, reigniting AI capex ROI narrative and driving re-rating toward $590 consensus PT; Fed holds rates steady providing dual tailwind.
ideas.bear_case: Azure misses guidance range and Fed turns hawkish on same day — double negative catalyst could accelerate the existing drawdown despite already-cheap valuation.
